header: Descriptive readout, no inference: six families x two cost bases, every t is marginal and no multiplicity correction is applied. Net only; between-slot rebalancing is uncosted in both books. Price-only (no dividends). Retrospective before the freeze, prospective after. The recorded commit identifies the code; it does not prove which bytes ran. Looks are listed from this checkout only; a final aborted run appears in the next vintage, or in none.
